_about: Correction target for observe.py learn propose and execute, format_version 1: the desired relationship between features, each with a tolerance.
Copy it beside features.json (for example ~/gpo-setup/target.json) and replace every FILL_ME. learn refuses this file while any FILL_ME remains.
Each quantity is one of: value (one feature value), difference (feature a minus feature b), point_to_line (signed distance in pixels from a dot or wire point to a seam line of the same camera).
Feature references come from features.json: values such as cam_a.wire.u, points such as cam_a.dot, lines such as cam_a.seam.
Units px, or mm only with px_per_mm and the calibration record it comes from; pixels are not millimetres without an independent calibration.
axes lists the axes the correction may move (from X, Y, Z, U, V, W); list no more axes than quantities, because each moved axis needs a quantity that observes it.
learn record --target target.json prints the current value of each quantity. Keys starting with _ are notes.
axes: FILL_ME: list of axes allowed to move, e.g. ["X", "Z"]

quantities.name: FILL_ME: e.g. cam_a dot to seam
FILL_ME: e.g. cam_b wire tip ahead of dot along u
